title: A notice you have received

items.title: Who sent it is clear
items.look_for: The sender, and the person they say they act for
items.why_it_matters: You need to know who is making the claim
items.question_to_ask: Who exactly is making this claim?

items.title: What is being claimed is stated
items.look_for: The amount, the act or the outcome demanded
items.why_it_matters: A vague demand is hard to answer and hard to settle
items.question_to_ask: What exactly is being asked for?

items.title: There is a deadline to respond
items.look_for: A number of days to reply or comply
items.why_it_matters: Missing a deadline can remove options later

items.title: Any sections cited are identified
items.look_for: References to sections of an Act
items.why_it_matters: Old code references still appear even though the codes changed on 1 July 2024
items.question_to_ask: Which provisions are actually being relied on?

items.title: The facts alleged are listed
items.look_for: Dates, amounts and events the sender relies on
items.why_it_matters: These are the facts you would need to accept or dispute
items.question_to_ask: Which of these facts do I agree with?

items.title: Documents relied on are identified
items.look_for: Agreements, receipts or messages the notice refers to
items.why_it_matters: You will want copies of everything it relies on
items.question_to_ask: Can I have copies of the documents referred to?

items.title: Any amount is broken down
items.look_for: How the amount claimed is made up
items.why_it_matters: An unexplained total is hard to check or dispute

items.title: The stated consequences are identified
items.look_for: What the sender says will happen if you do not comply
items.why_it_matters: It tells you how urgent the matter is
items.question_to_ask: What does the sender say will happen next?

items.title: How and when it was sent is recorded
items.look_for: The date, the mode of delivery and the address used
items.why_it_matters: Deadlines are usually counted from the date of service
items.question_to_ask: When was this sent and to which address?

items.title: There is an address to reply to
items.look_for: An address or email for the response
items.why_it_matters: A reply sent to the wrong place may not count
items.question_to_ask: Where should my reply be sent?

items.title: Any settlement option is identified
items.look_for: An offer to resolve the matter without further steps
items.why_it_matters: Settling early is often cheaper than the alternative
items.question_to_ask: Is there an option to settle this?

suggested_questions: What is this notice asking me to do?
By when do I have to respond?
Which sections does it rely on?
What does it say will happen if I do not respond?
What documents does it refer to?

scenarios.title: I do not reply at all
I disagree with the facts stated
I pay part of the amount claimed

facts_to_have_ready: The date the notice reached you
Your version of the events described
Any payments you have already made, with proof
Messages between you and the sender
documents_to_bring: The notice and the envelope or email showing the date
The agreement the notice refers to
Receipts or bank statements for any payment
Any earlier correspondence about the same matter
